hypotheses.statement: 未設定 TMPDIR 使 installer 以 /tmp 建立 candidate plist；macOS 將 /tmp 解析成 /private/tmp，因此 plist_receipt 的 canonical != path 條件必然拒絕。
evidence: manifest validation: plist_receipt rejects when path.resolve(strict=True) != path
host read-only check: /tmp is a symlink to private/tmp and both resolve to /private/tmp
ef2cdf9e47 exact argv contains no TMPDIR
b2995858c9 card records accepted/PASS with TMPDIR=/private/tmp

hypotheses.statement: plist error 是 owner mismatch，而非 noncanonical path。
evidence: the shared error joins two predicates, but canonical path inequality alone is sufficient
mktemp creates the file as the invoking user and no ownership-changing operation occurs before plist_receipt
the recorded recovery changes TMPDIR only; it does not change owner

hypotheses.statement: Publisher no-PID requires activation or reload before public preflight can pass。
evidence: validate_preactivation_transition explicitly accepts the exact rss_telemetry_unknown / loaded_service_pid_missing:* receipt shape
the same transition then requires all live services to be loaded with no PID and validates their inert topology
tests cover manifest-bound preactivation with loaded/no-PID and accept the transition without launchctl mutation

single_root_cause: Missing TMPDIR=/private/tmp caused the temporary capacity plist path to be noncanonical (/tmp/... versus resolved /private/tmp/...), so the transition rejected before it could treat Publisher no-PID as the expected preactivation topology.
